Package model

Class Menu

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
model.Menu
public class Menu extends Observable
Singleton class representing the main menu and user management for the blackjack game.

It handles user profiles, the dealer profile, game rules, number of decks, and the currently active user. This class also extends Observable to notify observers when changes occur, such as adding or removing profiles, or updating the current user.
